about: A line another published place leads is that place's: a published lock takes it only when every need it names is a leaf of the place, never because a later step of its scope names the place.
The place a line leads with is the first step of its scope, and a published place is a name some publish/<place>/bootstrap line holds: read off the standing, never listed from the tree.
